{{NPC infobox | name = Courier Falken | image = [[File:Shining Blade warrior.jpg|155px]] | affiliation = Shining Blade | type = Human | profession = Assassin | level = 20 | campaign = Prophecies | campaign2 = Factions | campaign3 = Beyond | map1 = [[File:Courier Falken North Kryta Province map.jpg|200px]] | map1-text = Path through North Kryta Province | map2 = [[File:Courier Falken Nebo Terrace map all routes.jpg|200px]] | map2-text = Path through Nebo Terrace | map3 = [[File:Courier Falken Watchtower Coast map.jpg|200px]] | map3-text = Path through Watchtower Coast | map4 = [[File:Canthan Courier Crisis map.png|200px]] | map4-text = Path through Bukdek Byway }} [[Courier Falken]] is a [[Shining Blade]] messenger that can be found relaying information throughout [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]]. He will randomly appear at [[portal]]s between Krytan [[zone]]s and start a messenger run along the road until he reaches another portal, fighting off [[White Mantle]] ambushes along the way. If you can successfully escort him from one portal to the other, he will reward you with gold, experience and [[War Supplies]]. After the civil war's end, [[Queen Salma]] sent the the Krytan courier on a [[Cantha Courier Crisis|diplomatic mission]] across the [[Unending Ocean|Clashing Seas]], the [[Cantha#Empire of the Dragon|Empire of the Dragon]] prospers, with an important letter for the [[Emperor Kisu|Ascendant Emperor of Cantha]]. ==Locations== *[[War in Kryta]] **{{NPC location|Lion's Arch (War in Kryta)}} **{{NPC location|Nebo Terrace (War in Kryta)}} **{{NPC location|North Kryta Province (War in Kryta)}} **{{NPC location|Watchtower Coast (War in Kryta)}} *[[Winds of Change]] **{{NPC location|Bukdek Byway (Winds of Change)}} (only during [[Cantha Courier Crisis]]) **{{NPC location|Kaineng Docks}} (only during [[Cantha Courier Crisis]]) ==Skills== *{{skill icon|Dash}} *{{skill icon|Shadow Refuge}} *{{skill icon|Brawling Block}} *{{skill icon|Brawling Jab}} *{{skill icon|Brawling Combo Punch}} *{{skill icon|Brawling Straight Right}} *{{skill icon|Brawling Uppercut}} *{{monster skill icon|Falken Punch}} *{{skill icon|Falken Quick}} ==Dialogue== *''"Only the courier that exceeds me has the right to become the next courier."'' *''"If you want to be my disciple you'll have to show me your moves first."'' *''"I bet I could train a rollerbeetle to deliver stuff for me."'' *''"Being a good courier isn't about being lucky, It's about being fast!"'' ;Alternate, upon winning: ''Thank you, [Character Name]. (6) | * Beetletun → Divinity Coast * Divinity Coast → Beetletun |} ==Notes== *If he dies during the escort, he will not resurrect and you will have to start again. *Consider bringing [["Make Haste!"]] or other [[IMS]] applicable to Allies when escorting him. *He doesn't count as your Shining Blade escort, so even when Falken appears, you'll get another of the randomly-chosen characters. Falken spawns standing near the portal, while the escort drops from a nearby tree. *In [[Hard mode]] a [[Jade construct]] with [[Spectral Agony]] will spawn with the last group. Falken isn't infused, so be extremely careful. ==Trivia== * Courier Falken is a parody of [[W:Captain Falcon|Captain Falcon]] (from the F-Zero and Super Smash Bros. series). ** The line ''"If you want to be my disciple you'll have to show me your moves first."'' is a reference to Captain Falcon's catchphrase, ''"Show me your moves!"'' ** The custom skill [[Falken Punch]] is a play on Captain Falcon's iconic ''Falcon Punch'' move. * ''"Delivery man, delivery man, does whatever a courier can. Transports packages, any size. Brushes off Mantle, just like flies. Oh yeah, here comes the delivery man."'' is an homage to the [[W:Spider-Man (theme song)|theme song]] of the 1967 [[W:Spider-Man|Spiderman]] cartoon. * ''"Come rain, or sleet, or horde of skale, ..."'' mimics the famous inscription at the [[W:James Farley Post Office|James Farley Post Office]] in New York (AKA the [[W:United States Postal Service creed|Post Officer's Creed]]). * ''"A courier's passion... is burning red!"'' is similar to the most famous phrase from [[W:Mobile Fighter G Gundam|Mobile fighter G Gundam]], in which the main character often says, ''THIS HAND OF MINE IS BURNING RED!''. * ''"GET SERIOUS"'' and ''"Are you okay?"'' are catch phrases used by [[W:Terry_Bogard|Terry Bogard]] in ''King of Fighter''. {{Minigames nav}} [[Category:References to films & tv series]] [[Category:References to video games]] [[Category:Prophecies minigames]]
